vulnerability_mechanism.evidence: CVE.org records CVE-2026-77014 as PUBLISHED and Red Hat CNA describes CWE-197: sort_ranges() subtracts two 64-bit goffset starts but returns int, so differences beyond INT_MAX can reverse sign. GitLab issue 519 demonstrates that the invalid ordering feeds the later overlap merge and silently drops the middle range from a 206 response for a 5,000,000,000-byte body. The vulnerable and fixed trees contain a matching regression test for ranges more than G_MAXINT apart.

atomic_bic.evidence: Vulnerability-first diff and line history identify 7aee2eeb1ca5aaad2162c0fb500a9d9a191a5e27 as the first public commit that adds sort_ranges(), the exact 'return ra->start - rb->start;' line, g_array_sort(), and the dependent merge loop. SoupRange.start was already goffset in that tree, so the 64-to-32 defect existed at first write.

immediate_parent_absence.evidence: 7aee2eeb has the single immediate parent e8e850b340fbcb51cbb7f950d102337b6a3cdf09. Exact parent-tree searches find neither sort_ranges nor 'ra->start - rb->start'; the parent has soup_message_headers_get_ranges() but lacks the newly added sorting and merge path.

squash_member_decomposition.evidence: The BIC is not a merge, move, refactor, revert, or squash aggregate: it is the single-parent git-svn conversion of public SVN revision 1181 and its focused diff adds 29 lines to one source file. No finer public member is reconstructable. MR !550 is separately decomposed: e82c13ba directly fixes this comparator, while 6ece9e52 and 546a59d2 address Content-Range validation and 416 response metadata.

affected_release_membership.evidence: Ancestry checks show the BIC absent from LIBSOUP_2_24_3 and present in LIBSOUP_2_25_1, the first containing tag dated 2008-11-04. It remains an ancestor of tag 3.7.2, whose tree still has the truncated comparator.

fixed_release_membership.evidence: e82c13ba is on local master and origin/master, but 'git tag --contains' returns no tag. The newest available tag, 3.7.2, predates and does not contain the fix; therefore the fix is verified on the development branch but no fixed release is evidenced in the clone.

direct_fix_or_unpatched_state.evidence: The direct fix is e82c13ba03defcee10f981ac964f4d570b21a251. Its parent f2af6b499cf23075ad73e065370cbb2e4eaceb6a still contains the truncated subtraction, while e82c13ba replaces it with an explicit three-way goffset comparison and adds tests for the exact issue-519 range pattern. The BIC is an ancestor of this fix; GitLab MR !550 lists the commit and is merged to master.

bic_only_ai_attribution.evidence: AI attribution was evaluated only on BIC 7aee2eeb. Its commit object names human author and committer Dan Winship <danw@src.gnome.org>, dated 2008-10-10, and contains only a conventional changelog plus the git-svn revision trailer. It has no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, bot identity, or other AI marker.

findings: The advisory is a real, non-withdrawn vulnerability: CVE.org state is PUBLISHED and GHSA-wmpg-2mpv-2hmm has withdrawn_at=null.
The primary record identifies the smallest surviving public first-write commit and verifies absence in its immediate parent.
The primary record correctly distinguishes the direct comparator fix from the other commits in merged MR !550 and correctly reports that no fixed tag is present.
BIC-only attribution supports NOT_AI because the 2008 human git-svn commit contains no AI marker.
